jsonSchemaCredentialId.description: Credential type of the offer. The agent derives no credential type yet, so every identifier answers UNKNOWN_ID.

claims.description: Claim values of the offered credential. Any subset of the configured claims, at least one, each non-empty; an omitted claim is left out of the credential.

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime of the credential in seconds, from 60 up to 7776000 (90 days). Nothing revokes the credential, so this lifetime is its only bound.

statusListId.description: Status list the credential is registered on, with statusListIndex. The agent hosts no status list yet, so every identifier answers UNKNOWN_ID.

statusListIndex.description: Index of the credential on that status list. Required whenever statusListId is present.

statusList.summary: Credential registered on a status list
